full_name: Phillip B. Williams | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Fiction & Poetry Helen Putnam Fellow Bennington College
bio: Phillip B. Williams is a Chicago native and the author of the poetry collection Thief in the Interior (Alice James Books, 2016). His artistic interests manifest through lyrical and narrative investigations of the aesthetic possibilities and historical implications of the grotesque and through (re)creation of Afro-diasporic mythologies within contemporary timeframes.
